title: Mussels in Italian Pilaf
description: A classic Italian dish featuring mussels cooked in a flavorful pilaf, perfect for a quick and satisfying dinner.

ingredients.name: mussels
ingredients.notes: fresh or frozen, scrubbed and debearded

ingredients.name: white wine
ingredients.notes: dry white wine, or substitute with chicken broth

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the mussels, white wine, lemon juice, and pilaf mix to the saucepan.
Stir to combine, then cover the saucepan with a lid.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the mussels are cooked through and the pilaf is tender.
Serve the mussels and pilaf hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
